Name: Salvation Smite
Description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the weapon burns like a lit lamp. The attack deals an extra 2d6 radiant damage to the target, and a further 2d6 if they are below half their maximum hit points. This attack cannot be non-lethal and after killing a creature, they cannot be revived by means below a True Resurrection or Wish spells, as their soul is viciously severed from the body.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.
